title: Chat with Looker Studio Pro Reports
text:

Real-time gait recognition
text:
You need a gait recognition system that runs in real-time across multiple cameras without sacrificing accuracy. My background in computer vision includes building lightweight detectors for edge deployment, such as a fabric defect system that processed 6,400 frames on an edge PC (portfolio repository: loom-inspect README). I also developed an invoice extraction pipeline using PyTorch and OpenCV, demonstrating proficiency in the core CV stack required for this task (portfolio repository: invoice-reader README).

For this project, I would start by curating a gait dataset and training a model optimized for low latency. I will then integrate it into NVIDIA Deep Stream to handle multi-camera streams efficiently. This approach ensures the model remains accurate while meeting real-time performance constraints.

Do you already have a labeled gait dataset, or do you need assistance with data collection and annotation?

title: Real Estate Financial Analysis
text:
Evaluating a real estate investment with two distinct financing sources, particularly an interest-only loan with a balloon payment, requires a model that accurately isolates cash flow impacts.

I have built financial models and cash-flow forecasts, including a three-statement model with scenario switches that was used in a successful pre-seed raise (portfolio case study: Financial model and cash-flow forecast). I also developed a forecasting system that integrates Python outputs directly into Excel for automated analysis (portfolio repository: stock-forecast README).

I will structure your model with clear inputs for both financing sources, ensuring metrics like debt service coverage ratio and payback period are dynamically linked to your assumptions. This approach allows you to stress-test the investment without manual recalculations. How do you prefer to handle the timing of the balloon payment in the cash flow schedule?
